example.title: Rainbow Row, East Bay Street (house 3 from the northern end)

brief: A three-storey Georgian row house in Charleston's Rainbow Row: stuccoed brick painted in a pastel colour, a shop-height ground floor, sash windows with shutters, a low parapet over a pitched roof, party walls both sides. One photo (house 3 of the row from the north). Older than 1970: Rainbow Row is 1740-1790; restored and painted 1930s-60s. Foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Rainbow Row
